title: Introduction to Solidity and Blockchain
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Introduction to Solidity and Blockchain and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 1: Introduction to Solidity and Blockchain; it lists all 10 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 1 roadmap: Introduction to Solidity; What Is Solidity?; History and Evolution of Solidity; Why Solidity Was Created; Where Solidity Is Used; Solidity and Smart Contracts; Understanding Blockchain Fundamentals; Introduction to Ethereum and the EVM; Advantages, Limitations, and Risks of Solidity; Prerequisites for Learning Solidity. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.

notes: Preserves numbered syllabus topics 1–10 from the attached Solidity PDF. Track: core. All content is draft pending subject-matter review.
